name: Premiere Pro Media Cache
detail: Peak and waveform files Premiere Pro, After Effects and Media Encoder share for every clip you've opened in any of them. Rebuilt the next time each clip is played or rendered.

name: Media Encoder Cache
detail: Media Encoder's own transcode cache. Rebuilt as queued jobs run again.

name: After Effects Disk Cache
detail: Per-frame render cache, kept in one folder per installed version. Rebuilt as you scrub or preview; comps and project files are untouched.

name: Photoshop Cache
detail: Photoshop's own scratch and preview cache, the same one Edit > Purge > All clears. Rebuilt from whatever documents are open.

name: Camera Raw Cache
detail: Decoded previews Photoshop and Lightroom Classic keep for raw files, rebuilt as you browse. Your edits live in the catalog or sidecar files, not here.

name: Lightroom Video Cache
detail: Cached video previews Lightroom Classic keeps for fast scrubbing. Rebuilt as you browse; the originals are untouched.

name: Ableton Live Decoding Cache
detail: Decoded copies of compressed samples (mp3, mov and similar) that Live keeps for playback. Live re-decodes and repopulates this automatically.

name: CapCut Cache
detail: Rendered previews and imported media CapCut caches while editing. Rebuilt as you work on a project; your projects and source footage are elsewhere.

name: Music Artwork
detail: Album and video artwork the Music and TV apps have downloaded. Refetched as you browse your library; nothing you own is stored here.

name: Spotify Cache
detail: Audio Spotify has buffered, including tracks downloaded for offline listening. Streams again over the network, so offline playlists have to re-download before they work away from a connection.
